newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 12.

text.p: -- Westinghouse Electric will likely announce on Wednesday plans to spin off its industrial operations into a new company with a separately traded stock, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing sources close to the situation. Westinghouse shares closed Monday at 20, up 1/2.
-- Molten Metal Technology Inc posted a third quarter loss of $0.14 a share, compared to a profit of $0.04 a year ago. Shares closed at 13-1/16.
-- News Corp posted first quarter earnings after the market close Monday of $0.27 a share before unusual items, flat with a year ago. Shares rose 1/4 to 16-3/8, a new 52-week high.

-- Bergen Brunswig Corp expects $30 million in annual cost savings from its merger with IVAX Corp and sees the merger as slightly dilutive in 1997 and becoming accretive in 1998, Chief Financial Officer Neil Dimick said.
Bergen Brunswig shares fell 5-1/8 to 27-5/8 and IVAX shares fell 3-3/8 to 12-3/8 after the merger was announced on Monday.
